doctrine: No claim is ever ESTABLISHED. The terminal state is UNKILLED — not yet killed — because when something survives, the most likely explanation is a missing kill path, not truth. A kill is constructive: it names a mechanism. A survival is absence of evidence and names nothing. A claim that survives has survived our IMAGINATION, not reality, so what matters is the DIVERSITY of kill-path families attempted, never the count of attempts — three attacks from one family is one attack. `kill_paths_named_but_not_tried` and `known_blind_spots` are the load-bearing fields: the unexamined directions carry the information. Age does not strengthen a claim, it weakens it — the substrate drifts underneath (measured: 8.6x, 2026-08-19). (James, 2026-08-23.)
